newsitem.title: UK: UK house prices rise 6.4% y/y in July - Halifax.
newsitem.headline: UK house prices rise 6.4% y/y in July - Halifax.

text.p: British house price inflation eased slightly in July, with prices rising a seasonally adjusted 0.1 percent compared with 0.3 percent in June and the annual growth rate dipping to 6.4 percent from 7.1 percent, Halifax Plc said.
Its seasonally adjusted house price index was 221.8 compared with a revised 221.6 in June.
"Although there was little rise in house prices in July, we continue to believe the housing market is well supported and recovery will continue," Britain's largest mortgage lender said.
Prices of new houses continued to fluctuate sharply, falling 0.4 percent in July.
The Halifax said it still expected British house prices to increase by 7.0 percent in the fourth quarter of 1997.
